title: ApproveExtractedMemories
description: Request to approve the memories extracted from one Context Center document.

source.description: The document, a context file or a page, whose Unprocessed extracted memories to approve.

approvable.description: The memories to approve, as the preview listed them. A memory that changed since, or that approval would no longer approve, is not approved; a memory the list does not name is left untouched.
